reuse.why: Changes only the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate, which every holiday-aware path (getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange) already calls.

duplication.why: The MM-DD matching is written once in a small isHoliday helper; nothing is copied.

placement.why: Holiday matching stays in shared/schedules.ts beside the weekend rule it extends.

scope.why: A three-line helper, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Minimal, well-commented change in the single definition of a non-working day.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No caller checks holidays outside isNonWorkingDay.
